exercises.question: (3) numaralı boşluk için en uygun kelimeyi seçin.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘inflicted’ (acı ya da zarar vermek): ‘inflict suffering on’ kalıbı ‘on’ edatıyla kurulur. ‘afflicted’ kişiyi doğrudan nesne alır (‘afflicted families’), ‘on’ ile kullanılmaz; ‘waived’ (vazgeçmek), ‘canvassed’ (oy toplamak) ve ‘deducted’ (düşmek) anlam vermez.

exercises.passage: The emperor's long (1)---- began with his ascent to the throne in 1888 and ended in 1918, when continual strikes and mutinies forced him to abdicate. Some historians blame his imperious manner and his contemptible treatment of parliament, and note that his attempts to rein in the generals failed; others point to the (2)---- of the economic system, in which a small imperial elite lived in luxurious palaces while the currency depreciated and workers could barely afford bread. The war (3)---- enormous suffering on ordinary families, many already afflicted by hunger, and dissent grew as morale collapsed. When soldiers began, as a matter of conscience, to refuse orders, an ineffectual government declared martial law, but it proved ineffective, and the iniquity of the violence perpetrated by the police only made people loathe the regime. Within weeks, revolution (4)----. Ironically, the emperor had formerly been admired as a moderniser, and many of his creditable reforms outlived him.
exercises.question: (4) numaralı boşluk için en uygun kelimeyi seçin.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘ensued’ (ardından geldi, patlak verdi): ‘ensue’ nesne almaz; devrim bu olayların ardından geldi. ‘ensured’ (sağlamak), ‘enveloped’ (sarmak), ‘persecuted’ (zulmetmek) ve ‘deprecated’ (kınamak) nesne ister, cümle yarım kalır.

exercises.question: Scientists study ---- changes, such as rising temperatures and shifting rainfall, to understand why some species are moving farther north each decade.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘climatic’ (iklimsel): sıcaklık ve yağıştaki değişimler iklim değişimleridir. ‘climactic’ (doruk noktasıyla ilgili) bir öykünün en heyecanlı anı için kullanılır; ‘casual’ (gelişigüzel), ‘biennial’ (iki yılda bir) ve ‘marital’ (evlilikle ilgili) anlam vermez.

exercises.question: In the film's ---- final scene, the hero at last confronts the officer who had persecuted his family, and the music rises to its loudest point.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘climactic’ (doruk noktasındaki): kahramanın düşmanıyla yüzleştiği son sahne filmin doruk noktasıdır. ‘climatic’ (iklimsel) hava ile ilgilidir; ‘humane’ (insancıl), ‘aural’ (işitsel) ve ‘casual’ (gelişigüzel) sahneyi bu anlamda nitelemez.

exercises.text: Each year thousands of young doctors ___, leaving their own country's hospitals short of staff, while far fewer doctors immigrate to replace them.
exercises.translation: Her yıl binlerce genç doktor yurt dışına göç ediyor ve kendi ülkelerinin hastanelerini personelsiz bırakıyor; onların yerini almak için gelen doktor sayısı ise çok daha az.

exercises.text: The fire spread so quickly that within an hour the whole forest was ___ in thick smoke.
exercises.translation: Yangın öyle hızlı yayıldı ki bir saat içinde bütün orman yoğun dumanla kaplandı.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 15 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The company was fined for ---- environmental rules, and critics said its executives, who were openly dismissive of the damage while flaunting record profits, deserved formal censure.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘flouting’ (kuralları hiçe saymak): çevre kurallarını çiğnediği için ceza alan şirket kurallara uymamıştır. ‘flaunting’ (gösteriş yapmak) bu sesteş karışıklığın tuzağıdır; ‘appraising’ (değer biçmek), ‘apprising’ (bilgilendirmek) ve ‘alluding’ (ima etmek) kuralla anlam kurmaz.

exercises.question: Before the vote, the committee was ---- of the risks by independent experts who had appraised the site, so no member could later claim that the dangers had eluded them.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘apprised’ (bilgilendirilmek): ‘be apprised of’ kalıbı bir şeyden haberdar edilmek demektir. ‘appraised’ (değer biçilmek) ‘of’ ile kullanılmaz; ‘deprecated’ (kınanmak), ‘censured’ (resmen kınanmak) ve ‘eluded’ (kaçılmak) uzmanların işlevini anlatmaz.

exercises.question: Because the auditor owned shares in the company, his judgement of its accounts could not be considered ----, though he was hardly uninterested in them, and his report did not survive public scrutiny or judicial review.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘disinterested’ (tarafsız, çıkarı olmayan): şirkette hissesi olan denetçinin kişisel çıkarı vardır, bu yüzden yargısı tarafsız sayılamaz. ‘uninterested’ (ilgisiz, meraksız) yaygın bir karıştırmadır ve cümle zaten onun ilgisiz olmadığını söylüyor; ‘incredulous’ (inanamayan), ‘credulous’ (saf) ve ‘reticent’ (suskun) gerekçeyle bağ kurmaz.

exercises.question: Parliament voted to ---- the minister for misleading MPs about the contract and for remarks that seemed to incite anger against judges, although it stopped short of forcing her to resign.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘censure’ (resmen kınamak): meclis bakanı kınadı ama istifaya zorlamadı. ‘elude’ (kaçmak), ‘allude’ (ima etmek), ‘flaunt’ (gösteriş yapmak) ve ‘depreciate’ (değer kaybetmek) bir meclis kararını anlatmaz.

exercises.question: His smile was only ----: within seconds his face became serious again, for the letter contained momentous news about his marital future.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘momentary’ (anlık, kısa süreli): gülümseme saniyeler içinde kayboldu. ‘momentous’ (tarihî, çok önemli) sık karıştırılan çifttir ama süre bildirmez; ‘fortuitous’ (rastlantısal), ‘definitive’ (kesin) ve ‘practicable’ (uygulanabilir) bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: The plan is ambitious but hardly ----: amid such market volatility, there is neither the money nor enough industrious staff to carry it out, and no waiver of the spending rules is likely, which leaves ministers in an invidious position.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘practicable’ (uygulanabilir): ne para ne personel olduğu için plan uygulanamaz. ‘precipitous’ (ani, dik), ‘imperious’ (buyurgan), ‘luxurious’ (lüks) ve ‘amoral’ (ahlak dışı) planın uygulanabilirliğini anlatmaz.

exercises.question: After the scandal, the share price suffered a ---- fall as speculation spread, losing half its value in a single day; the timing, critics said, was hardly fortuitous.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘precipitous’ (ani ve keskin): bir günde değerin yarısını kaybetmek ani bir düşüştür. ‘practicable’ (uygulanabilir), ‘judicious’ (sağduyulu), ‘biennial’ (iki yılda bir) ve ‘humane’ (insancıl) bir düşüşü nitelemez.

exercises.question: Doctors were ---- when the patient, who had been afflicted by the disease for years and had received no treatment at all, recovered completely within a week.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘incredulous’ (inanamayan): tedavisiz tam iyileşme doktorları şaşkınlıkla inanamaz hâle getirir. ‘credulous’ (her şeye inanan) bunun tersidir; ‘creditable’ (övgüye değer), ‘contemptible’ (aşağılık) ve ‘complacent’ (rehavete kapılmış) tepkiyi anlatmaz.

exercises.question: Many critics found the novel's hero ----: he lies, steals and betrays his friends without any sense that right and wrong even exist; his acts are immoral, but he has no idea of morality at all.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘amoral’ (ahlak dışı, ahlak duygusu olmayan): doğru ile yanlışın varlığından bile habersiz kahraman ahlak kavramının dışındadır. ‘humane’ (insancıl), ‘reticent’ (suskun), ‘industrious’ (çalışkan) ve ‘judicious’ (sağduyulu) bu davranışlarla çelişir.

exercises.question: After the authorities gave their assent, the ---- of the mountain took the climbers three days in harsh climatic conditions, but the descent, on icy slopes, was even more dangerous.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘ascent’ (tırmanış): dağın tırmanışı ile inişi (‘descent’) karşılaştırılıyor. ‘assent’ (onay) cümlede yetkililer için ayrıca geçiyor, ‘dissent’ (muhalefet) de sesteş bir tuzaktır; ‘eminence’ (saygınlık) ve ‘stimulant’ (uyarıcı) dağla anlam kurmaz.

exercises.question: Although the drug, developed by a chemist of great eminence, proved efficacious in the laboratory, ----.
options: it was largely ineffective in patients, whose bodies broke it down too quickly
it therefore worked equally well in every patient
because the patients took it regularly
which is why doctors prescribed it so widely
so its inventors were awarded a major prize
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘it was largely ineffective in patients, whose bodies broke it down too quickly’: ‘although’ laboratuvardaki başarıya karşıt bir sonuç ister. ‘worked equally well’, ‘prescribed it so widely’ ve ‘awarded a major prize’ başarıyı sürdürür, karşıtlık kurmaz; ‘because the patients…’ ana cümle değildir.

exercises.question: ----, the newspaper published a full apology for its regrettable error, and its regretful editor expressed sympathy for the singer.
options: Since its reporters had checked every fact beforehand
Unless the singer agrees to give an interview
So as to sell even more copies of the story
Having realised that its story about the singer's marital problems was false
Despite having no reason to regret anything
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘Having realised that its story about the singer's marital problems was false’: haberin yanlış olduğunu anlayan gazete özür diler. ‘checked every fact’ ve ‘no reason to regret’ özrü gereksiz kılar; ‘Unless…’ şimdiki zamanla geçmiş olayı bağlayamaz; ‘sell even more copies’ özürle çelişir.

exercises.question: The new law aims to protect tenants, whose rents have risen at a precipitous rate, ----.
options: so that landlords can evict them more easily
because tenants rarely pay their rent on time
by limiting how much landlords can raise the rent each year
although its basic tenets were never written down
which landlords welcomed as a luxurious gift
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘by limiting how much landlords can raise the rent each year’: kira artışını sınırlamak kiracıyı korumanın yoludur. ‘evict them more easily’ korumayla çelişir; ‘rarely pay their rent’ korumayı açıklamaz; ‘basic tenets’ ve ‘luxurious gift’ ise anlamsızdır.

exercises.passage: English contains many pairs of words that look or sound alike but differ in meaning, such as 'complementary' and 'complimentary', 'stationary' and 'stationery', 'canvas' and 'canvass', 'allusion' and 'illusion', 'ingenious' and 'ingenuous', 'aural' and 'oral', or 'casual' and 'causal'. Such pairs are a well-known trap in the English lexicon, and even editors of great eminence sometimes miss them. Spell-checkers rarely help, because both words in each pair are correctly spelt, so even a legible, carefully edited text may contain them. The safest approach, linguists suggest, is to learn each pair together, with one memorable example for each word, rather than studying the words separately.
exercises.question: According to the passage, spell-checkers are of little help because ----.
options: native speakers never use these pairs
they work only with very simple words
both words in such pairs are real, correctly spelt words
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘both words in such pairs are real, correctly spelt words’: metin iki sözcüğün de doğru yazıldığını, bu yüzden yazım denetiminin hatayı yakalayamadığını söylüyor. ‘native speakers never use’ metinle çelişir; ‘very simple words’ ve ‘switch them off’ metinde yoktur; ‘study the words separately’ ise yazım denetimiyle değil öğrenme yöntemiyle ilgilidir.

exercises.passage: When a new virus appeared, many governments, averse to spending money, were complacent, assuming in a simplistic way that the outbreak would remain a local problem. By the time the disease had become a pandemic, it proved exceedingly hard to contain, and some states even declared martial law. In hindsight, the warning signs were clear: epidemiologists had for years, in biannual reports, described the threat as insidious, since asymptomatic people could spread the virus before feeling any discomfort. The report argues that judicious spending on preparation would have cost far less than the emergency measures that ensued, when governments finally acted purposefully and had to waive their normal spending rules.
exercises.question: The report suggests that governments ----.
options: were right to treat the virus as a local problem
should have invested in preparation before the outbreak
spent too much money on preparation
could not have known about the threat
acted quickly enough to protect hospitals
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘should have invested in preparation before the outbreak’: rapor hazırlığa yapılacak sağduyulu harcamanın sonradan gelen önlemlerden ucuz olacağını söylüyor. ‘right to treat the virus as a local problem’ rehaveti haklı çıkarır; ‘spent too much’ ve ‘acted quickly enough’ metinle çelişir; ‘could not have known’ ise uyarıların açık olduğu bilgisiyle çelişir.
